description: The pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," illustrates the distribution of token routing across three categories: LOCAL, LLM, and EDGE_P2P. The majority of tokens are routed locally, represented by a large green segment that accounts for 94.5% of the total. The LLM category is depicted by a red segment, comprising 3.9% of the distribution, while the EDGE_P2P category is shown as a smaller blue segment, making up 1.6%. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of local routing through the size of the green slice and the use of an exploded segment for the smaller categories, which are positioned at the top left. The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice, and the labels for each category are placed adjacent to their respective segments.
